description.Description: A textual description for the organization security policy.

display_name.Description: A textual name of the security policy.

fingerprint.Description:
Fingerprint of this resource. This field is used internally during
updates of this resource.

parent.Description:
The parent of this OrganizationSecurityPolicy in the Cloud Resource Hierarchy.
Format: organizations/{organization_id} or folders/{folder_id}

policy_id.Description: The unique identifier for the resource. This identifier is defined by the server.

type.Description:
The type indicates the intended use of the security policy.
For organization security policies, the only supported type
is "FIREWALL". Default value: "FIREWALL" Possible values: ["FIREWALL"]
